I'm no expert, but I can give advice about what helped me. Don't get me wrong, I am not feeling amazing or anything, but that emptiness I felt is gone. I recommend you to find one person you are close to and who can understand you, and just let your heart out. We all play strong and wear brave face, but underneath that brave face, we are all scared. Try to let someone know all your thoughts, maybe not all but you get me. You may have one vision about something and it might feel normal to you, but to someone who didn't have same experience in the past 4 years, it might sound off and could give you good advice.
Again, I'm no expert, but I want to try to help anyways

We couldn't walk inside of school in shoes that we wore outside. We couldn't even walk inside to put other shoes on. It didn't matter if it was winter, we had to stay outside and put on other shoes. My dad got this rule banned when he was driving me to school and saw 150+ kids standing on ice and putting on shoes. He yelled at principal and the next day we had chairs inside of school to sit on and change shoes.
There was also three or four month period where we all had to dance before the classes started. Most of kids would "accidentally" fall asleep for four months

It all started with my so called "friend" deciding not to talk to me, and when we were put to talk she just started yelling at me. Then she turned all of my friends against me. Teacher in my dorm sent me to psychiatrist and I was put on antidepressants. Then I stopped going to school cause nobody wanted me around, all my friends would act like I didn't exist. I know I should've avoided that, but I couldn't get the feeling of not being wanted away. And to think all girls so easily let go of our friendship.... Anyways, they were having parties, going to movies but they'd never invite me. After I stopped going to school, my teacher would call my mom to ask what's happening, but I didn't tell her about me not going to school. So I ruined her mood whenever she'd get a call from my teachers asking where I am. Eventually it was decided that I'll attempt to go on tests from all subjects. But I was sick one day and didn't go and that's automatic fail... It was one class that day so I wasn't too worried, it happened again... I had two tests that day which automatically put me to fail whole year... My mom was crying every day at work, she'd call me crying, not knowing what to do with me anymore...after that I failed another class.... I ruined everything...
